address: 19 rue du Bac, à Sainte-Marine, Combrit, 29120, France
bio: This quaint Breton eatery, located on the quayside of Sainte-Marine's little port opposite Bénodet Island, celebrates the sea. The terrace affords picturesque views over the River Odet, the dining area is painted blue and white, as are the guestrooms, and the maritime theme is pursued in the no-frills seafood score....
